commands_used: answer 1. I woke in a barge hold among strangers; the door is locked. An Argonian woman, Okeeh, is watching me. I do not know why I am here or who I work for. 2. Speak to Okeeh at Barge Hold (marker). 3. Talk to Okeeh; other options unknown. There is a locked door, I have a lockpick, and other people (Dralin Uveran) and creatures are nearby. 4. I do not understand where Ashgate Landing is, who Okeeh or Dralin Uveran are, or what the work roll means. I could find out by talking to people.
pick Door to Barge Hold win

answer 1. I am on a work barge at Ashgate Landing, Black Marsh, with a gang serving the Owing: months of owed work cutting reed instead of a cell. Gang-master Dralin Uveran will take names onto his roll; until then the door is locked. 2. Tell Okeeh my trade, here in the Barge Hold, after giving my name. 3. The game offers seven trade topics (fighter, hunter, thief, poultice-maker among them); I will see them. 4. I do not fully understand what the Owing really is, what a Hist is, or Jal-Veesa; Okeeh has topics on these I can ask about.

answer 1. I told Okeeh I was a hunter; the door has been unbarred. The gang-master Dralin Uveran waits outside to take my name onto his roll. 2. Go out through the Barge Hold door onto the landing at Ashgate Landing and speak to Dralin. 3. Go out now, or first ask Okeeh more (Owing, Hist, Jal-Veesa). 4. I still do not know what a Hist or Jal-Veesa is; Okeeh has topics for them.

answer 1. My name was struck from the Owing roll on orders of Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, so I owe no months. She wants Sithis beard moss from Reed-Sill Weir and will have work for me. Dralin does not know why. 2. Choose a piece of gear from Dralin (talk to him), then go east to Reed-Sill Weir for Sithis beard, mind crocodiles, then to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa. 3. Choose warhammer, sword, bamboo bow with arrows and knife, or Sparks tome, or decline. As a hunter I lean to the bow. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, who has friends in high places for me, or what Jal-Veesa and its tree are; I can ask around.

answer 1. I got a bamboo bow, 20 flint arrows and a flint knife from Dralin. My Owing debt was cancelled on Vosh-Leera's order. 2. Go east up the road to Reed-Sill Weir, gather Sithis beard moss, then take it to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa. 3. Walk to the weir, fight or avoid the crocodiles with the bow, or ask Dralin more questions first. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, or what Sithis beard is for, or what a Hist is; Dralin has topics on them.

answer 1. The quest No Name on the Work Roll is complete. I am Wanderer, a hunter, freed from the Owing by an order from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, who wants Sithis beard moss. I carry a bamboo bow, 20 flint arrows, a flint knife, 2 lockpicks, 0 gold. 2. Go east up the road to Reed-Sill Weir, pick Sithis beard, then take it to Vosh-Leera in Jal-Veesa. 3. Go straight to the weir, or ask Dralin and Okeeh more first; fight or avoid the crocodiles at the weir with the bow. 4. I do not know why Vosh-Leera wants me, what a Hist is, or what Jal-Veesa's tree is. I could ask Dralin, Okeeh, or people in Jal-Veesa.

answer I am Wanderer, a hunter, now free of the Owing (reed-cutting service) at Ashgate Landing, Black Marsh. Dralin Uveran, the Dunmer gang-master, struck my name on orders from Vosh-Leera, root-herald of Jal-Veesa, who speaks for the town elders and tree. I carry a bamboo bow, 20 flint arrows (pick them up after use), a flint knife, 2 lockpicks, 0 gold. Next: go east up the road to Reed-Sill Weir, the weir-wardens camp, pick grey Sithis beard moss from the woven weir (watch for crocodiles under it), then take it to Vosh-Leera house in Jal-Veesa. Unknown: why she wants me, what a Hist is, and what Jal-Veesa tree is. Okeeh the cook is in the barge hold and Dralin is on the landing if you want to ask them more.
